35	
36	Several key adoption metrics emerged from the 2024 data:
37	
38	- **Mobile OS**: 33% of traffic came from iOS devices. Apple iOS and Google Android remain the dominant mobile operating systems, with peak Android traffic share exceeding 95% in some regions and peak iOS reaching around 66%.
39	- **HTTP/3**: 21% of traffic uses HTTP/3, the most recent version of the protocol that runs on top of QUIC, providing faster connections, packet-loss mitigation, and encryption by default.

41	- **Browsers**: Chrome remains the most popular browser globally.
42	- **API Client Languages**: Go is the most popular API client language with approximately 12% of automated API requests, followed by Node.js, Python (9.6%), Java (7.4%), and .NET (3.6%).
43	
44	Post-quantum encryption saw a dramatic surge in adoption during 2024. Starting at around 2% of TLS 1.3 traffic in early 2024, adoption jumped sharply following Google Chrome 124 enabling post-quantum key agreement by default on April 17, rapidly climbing to approximately 12-13%. Mozilla Firefox has also started rolling out post-quantum by default, and Apple Safari began initial testing.
45	
46	![Post-quantum encrypted traffic worldwide showing rapid adoption after Chrome 124 release](./assets/post-quantum-encryption-adoption.jpg)
47

49

58	| Unknown              | 16    |

60	| Technical Problem    | 9     |

71

75

# Cloudflare Radar 2024 Year in Review

## Source

URL: https://radar.cloudflare.com/year-in-review/2024

The Cloudflare Radar 2024 Year in Review provides a comprehensive view of Internet patterns and trends observed through Cloudflare's global network during 2024. The report covers traffic growth, popular services, technology adoption, connectivity disruptions, security threats, and email security trends. Data is derived from Cloudflare's position as a provider protecting and accelerating websites and applications for millions of customers worldwide.

## Internet Traffic Growth and Popular Services

Global Internet traffic grew by 17% in 2024, continuing the upward trend driven by increasing reliance on the Internet for communication, commerce, entertainment, and transportation. The trend line starts mid-January to normalize for post-holiday activity.

Google maintained its position as the most popular Internet service overall, topping the rankings for the second consecutive year. Generative AI continued its rapid rise throughout 2024, while the Metaverse receded into the background. The ranking methodology is based on aggregate data from Cloudflare's 1.1.1.1 DNS resolver.

| Rank | Service   |
|------|-----------|
| #1   | Google    |
| #2   | Facebook  |
| #3   | Apple     |
| #4   | TikTok    |
| #5   | AWS       |
| #6   | Microsoft |
| #7   | Instagram |
| #8   | YouTube   |
| #9   | Amazon    |
| #10  | WhatsApp  |

![Top 10 most popular Internet services worldwide](./assets/top-10-internet-services.jpg)

SpaceX Starlink traffic saw dramatic 3.3x growth during 2024, continuing to bring satellite Internet connectivity to previously underserved locations. Starlink is not yet available globally; the trend line is scaled relative to peak observed request volume.

![Normalized Starlink traffic worldwide showing 3.3x growth in 2024](./assets/starlink-traffic-growth-2024.jpg)

## Technology Adoption and Usage Patterns

Several key adoption metrics emerged from the 2024 data:

NAVY_MID    = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1E, 0x3C)   # card / table header bg
NAVY_LIGHT  = RGBColor(0x1C, 0x2A, 0x4A)   # alternate row
ORANGE_CF   = RGBColor(0xF6, 0x82, 0x1F)   # Cloudflare orange accent
WHITE       = RGBColor(0xFF, 0xFF, 0xFF)
LIGHT_GRAY  = RGBColor(0xC0, 0xCC, 0xDE)

ACCENT_PURPLE = RGBColor(0xA7, 0x8B, 0xFA)

SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

prs.slide_width  = SLIDE_W
prs.slide_height = SLIDE_H

def set_slide_bg(slide, color=NAVY_DARK):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)

    tf.word_wrap = True

        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox

    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape

def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_rich_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, runs_list, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    """runs_list: list of (text, font_size, color, bold, font_name)"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, (text, sz, color, bold, fn) in enumerate(runs_list):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(sz)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = fn
        p.alignment = alignment
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox

def build_table(slide, left, top, width, height, headers, rows,
                header_bg=NAVY_MID, row_bg1=NAVY_MID, row_bg2=NAVY_LIGHT,
                header_color=ORANGE_CF, text_color=WHITE, font_size=11):
    """Create a styled table on the slide."""
    n_rows = len(rows) + 1
    n_cols = len(headers)
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, left, top, width, height)
    table = table_shape.table

    # Column widths
    col_w = width // n_cols
    for ci in range(n_cols):
        table.columns[ci].width = col_w

    # Header row
    for ci, hdr in enumerate(headers):
        cell = table.cell(0, ci)
        cell.text = hdr
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_bg
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
            p.font.color.rgb = header_color
            p.font.bold = True
            p.font.name = "Calibri"
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

    # Data rows
    for ri, row in enumerate(rows):
        for ci, val in enumerate(row):
            cell = table.cell(ri + 1, ci)
            cell.text = str(val)
            cell.fill.solid()
            cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = row_bg1 if ri % 2 == 0 else row_bg2
            for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
                p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
                p.font.color.rgb = text_color
                p.font.bold = False
                p.font.name = "Calibri"
                p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

    return table_shape


def add_bullet_list(slide, left, top, width, height, items, font_size=13,
                    color=LIGHT_GRAY, bullet_color=ORANGE_CF):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, item in enumerate(items):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        # bullet char + text
        run_b = p.add_run()
        run_b.text = "▸  "
        run_b.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run_b.font.color.rgb = bullet_color
        run_b.font.bold = True
        run_b.font.name = "Calibri"

        run_t = p.add_run()
        run_t.text = item
        run_t.font.size = Pt(font_size)
        run_t.font.color.rgb = color
        run_t.font.bold = False
        run_t.font.name = "Calibri"
        p.space_after = Pt(6)
    return txBox

NAVY_MID    = RGBColor(0x14, 0x1E, 0x3C)   # card / table header bg

ORANGE_CF   = RGBColor(0xF6, 0x82, 0x1F)   # Cloudflare orange accent

MID_GRAY    = RGBColor(0x8A, 0x99, 0xB4)
ACCENT_BLUE = RGBColor(0x3B, 0x82, 0xF6)
ACCENT_GREEN= RGBColor(0x22, 0xC5, 0x5E)
ACCENT_RED  = RGBColor(0xEF, 0x44, 0x44)
ACCENT_PURPLE = RGBColor(0xA7, 0x8B, 0xFA)

SLIDE_H = Inches(7.5)

# ── Helper functions ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
def set_slide_bg(slide, color=NAVY_DARK):
    bg = slide.background
    fill = bg.fill
    fill.solid()
    fill.fore_color.rgb = color


def add_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, text, font_size=14,
                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox


def add_rich_textbox(slide, left, top, width, height, runs_list, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT):
    """runs_list: list of (text, font_size, color, bold, font_name)"""
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    for i, (text, sz, color, bold, fn) in enumerate(runs_list):
        if i == 0:
            p = tf.paragraphs[0]
        else:
            p = tf.add_paragraph()
        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(sz)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = fn
        p.alignment = alignment
        p.space_after = Pt(4)
    return txBox


def add_accent_line(slide, left, top, width, color=ORANGE_CF, height=Pt(3)):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    return shape


def add_card(slide, left, top, width, height, fill_color=NAVY_MID):
    shape = slide.shapes.add_shape(MSO_SHAPE.ROUNDED_RECTANGLE, left, top, width, height)
    shape.fill.solid()
    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = fill_color
    shape.line.fill.background()
    shape.shadow.inherit = False
    return shape


def add_stat_card(slide, left, top, width, height, number, label,
                  num_color=ORANGE_CF, fill_color=NAVY_MID):

                number, font_size=32, color=num_color, bold=True,
                alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)

                label, font_size=12, color=LIGHT_GRAY, bold=False,
                alignment=PP_ALIGN.CENTER)
    return card


def build_table(slide, left, top, width, height, headers, rows,
                header_bg=NAVY_MID, row_bg1=NAVY_MID, row_bg2=NAVY_LIGHT,
                header_color=ORANGE_CF, text_color=WHITE, font_size=11):

    n_cols = len(headers)
    table_shape = slide.shapes.add_table(n_rows, n_cols, left, top, width, height)

    # Column widths

        table.columns[ci].width = col_w

    # Header row

        cell = table.cell(0, ci)
        cell.text = hdr
        cell.fill.solid()
        cell.fill.fore_color.rgb = header_bg
        for p in cell.text_frame.paragraphs:
            p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
            p.font.color.rgb = header_color
            p.font.bold = True
            p.font.name = "Calibri"
            p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
        cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

                p.font.color.rgb = text_color
                p.font.bold = False
                p.font.name = "Calibri"
                p.alignment = PP_ALIGN.CENTER
            cell.vertical_anchor = MSO_ANCHOR.MIDDLE

    return table_shape

        run_t.font.color.rgb = color
        run_t.font.bold = False
        run_t.font.name = "Calibri"

    return txBox

                color=WHITE, bold=False, alignment=PP_ALIGN.LEFT, font_name="Calibri"):
    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True
    p = tf.paragraphs[0]
    p.text = text
    p.font.size = Pt(font_size)
    p.font.color.rgb = color
    p.font.bold = bold
    p.font.name = font_name
    p.alignment = alignment
    return txBox

    txBox = slide.shapes.add_textbox(left, top, width, height)
    tf = txBox.text_frame
    tf.word_wrap = True

        p.text = text
        p.font.size = Pt(sz)
        p.font.color.rgb = color
        p.font.bold = bold
        p.font.name = fn
        p.alignment = alignment

    return txBox

    shape.fill.fore_color.rgb = color
    shape.line.fill.background()

    shape.line.fill.background()
